say:1:1623312001:2.text: Merlin... Magister... you're not here to drag me back to class, are you?

say:2:1623312002:0.text: I'm sorry... I'm not ditching class on purpose. I just... I'm scared of magic right now.
say:2:1623312002:0.source_cn: 对不起，对不起，我……我真的不是故意翘课的，只是我……...

say:3:1623312003:1.text: One of my closest friends lost her magic because of that contract... I saw it happen. One second she was fine, and the next she just collapsed...

say:4:1623312004:1.text: Ever since then, whenever someone mentions magic, I see that moment again. It makes my chest tighten.
say:4:1623312004:1.source_cn: 自从那天以后，一提到魔法，我脑子里就满是她倒在地上的样...

say:4:1623312004:1.female: Ever since then, whenever someone mentions magic, I see that moment again. It makes my chest tighten.
